fact: Countdown to 2030 and APHRC held a national workshop on 3-7 November 2025 training district-level focal points to analyse and use data from Mauritania's National Health Information System (SNIS), with practical sessions in DHIS2.

The Countdown 2030 chartbook report assesses national DHIS2 health-facility data for 2019-2024 by district and region, covering national trends, and reports that district report completeness is low against target.
